WriteText.ai is a plugin for WordPress/WooCommerce aimed at automating the creation of meta titles, meta descriptions, product descriptions, Open Graph texts, and image alt texts. It operates in two modes: 'WriteText.ai Single' and 'WriteText.ai Bulk'. The 'Single' mode offers detailed configuration before text generation, while the 'Bulk' mode generates content for multiple products efficiently and without supervision.

The tool allows connections to unlimited e-commerce sites and supports multiple user accounts at no additional cost.

The 1.30 update introduces AI-powered keyword research, automatic keyword ranking checks, competitor keyword insights, data on basic search intent, and a 'Special Instructions' field in bulk generation.

WriteText.ai Single
This mode lets users define tone, style, and target audience, engage in detailed keyword analysis, and select semantic keywords and specific product attributes for the generated content. Text is created within 50 seconds, allowing users the chance to review and adjust before publication. This mode is optimized for crafting custom content for specific audience needs, with a focus on SEO.

WriteText.ai Bulk
For simultaneous content creation across multiple products, the bulk mode allows selection of several products to generate text in one go, maintaining consistent tone, style, and attributes. Optimized for speed and efficiency, this mode is perfect for large-scale content creation needs.

Languages Supported
To serve a global audience, WriteText.ai supports multiple languages including Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Catalan, Dutch, and Italian. It automatically generates content in the language of your WooCommerce webshop, enhancing reach and engagement across regions. If the language is unavailable, the default output is in English.

Features Include
- Connection to unlimited e-commerce sites and user accounts
- Direct content transfer and publication to WooCommerce
- Selection of product attributes, tone, and style
- Customizable content length, target audience, and user roles
- Advanced image analysis for more precise and engaging descriptions
- AI suggestions for target markets and custom market definitions
- Keyword analysis and semantic keyword integration
- AI-powered keyword research and analysis
- Automatic checking of keywords currently ranking on product pages
- Insights into competitor keywords

- Keyword density tracking for SEO
- Text rewriting
- Reference product to ensure tone, style, and layout consistency
- Content review history log and bulk content management
- Multi-store support

items.long_description:
WriteText.ai is an AI-driven description generator for Magento that automatically creates meta titles, meta descriptions, product descriptions, short descriptions, Open Graph texts, and image alt texts directly in your Magento backend.

Features:
- Supports an unlimited number of ecommerce sites and user accounts.
- Facilitates seamless transfer and publishing to Magento.
- Allows selection of product attributes, tone, and style.
- Enables customization of content length, target audience, and user roles.
- Enhances text by analyzing product images for additional details, providing more accurate and engaging descriptions, especially useful for products with limited information or complex names.
- Offers AI-powered recommendations for target markets.
- Provides keyword analysis and semantic keyword recommendations.
- Tracks keyword density to optimize content for search engines.
- Allows for the rewriting of text to improve or adjust content.
- Ensures content matches the tone, style, and layout of an existing product for consistency.
- Features a content review history log and supports bulk content management.
- Offers support for managing content across multiple stores.
- Includes a Chrome extension to help manage content and tag products for accuracy checks or revisions.

In WriteText.ai Single mode, it allows users to meticulously define the tone, style, and target audience for an individual product. It enables detailed keyword analysis, selection of semantic keywords, and inclusion of specific product attributes in the generated text. WriteText.ai crafts customized content within about 50 seconds, providing the opportunity for users to review and tweak the text before it goes live. This mode is specially designed to create personalized content tailored to specific audience requirements, with a strong emphasis on SEO optimization.

On the other hand, WriteText.ai Bulk mode is designed for efficiently generating content for multiple products at once. Users can select a batch of products and apply a uniform tone, style, and attributes to all of them. This mode maximizes speed and efficiency, greatly simplifying the content generation process for handling large volumes or high-scale operations.

Version 1.2 of WriteText.ai enhances global accessibility by supporting multiple languages, including Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Catalan, Dutch, and Italian. This functionality enables businesses to automatically generate content in the primary language of their Magento site, thereby expanding their market reach and enhancing global customer interactions. WriteText.ai automatically adjusts its output to the language settings of your site; if a specific language is not supported, it defaults to English. Translation of the user interface is currently in progress to further improve usability.
